mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it indicates labor market weakness that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP and housing starts indicates robust consumer demand, driving equity market expansion over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of GDPC1 growth and HOUST increase fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over 60-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, strong industrial production growth signals sustained corporate output and profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: Robust retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, indicate strong consumer spending which directly supports corporate revenue growth, yielding positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS is rising.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.5%, it triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment and declining unemployment indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer income and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to produce positive returns in more than 50% of cases over 60-day horizons.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising FEDFUNDS rates increase cost of capital, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS is rising.
